Name: DM Voice Pack SVE English (No longer Maintained)
Author: Darkmushu1
Description:
I'm quitting modding to explore other things in life, whoever wants to take over the project and or maintain just let me know and I can add a redirect link here to your Nexus mod page.

English Voice Pack for Stardew Valley Expanded. 
Note if you want to hear the Vanilla Character speaking the Stardew Valley Expanded dialogues, you'll also need to get [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33063]DM Voice Pack English for Vanilla Characters[/url]

This voice pack can't be played unless you have the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33061]voice over framework mod [/url]installed.
This voice pack is for all Stardew Valley Expanded Characters dialogue in English.

[b]Credits & Permissions[/b]
Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/46021252]FlashShifter[/url] for granting me permission to use the dialogue assets for the voice pack, and allowing me to create this AI voice pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]. 

[b]About This Voice Pack[/b]
All audio in this voice pack was generated using licensed voices from ElevenLabs’ Voice Library while I held an active commercial creator license (Scale Plan). These voices are provided by professional voice actors who have chosen to share their voices publicly through ElevenLabs.
Each time a library voice is used, the original voice actor receives royalties based on usage, ensuring fair compensation for their contribution.
This project complies fully with ElevenLabs’ terms of service and supports ethical use of AI voice technology.

Feel free to use only the ones you like and swap the out for other voices from others.

If this mod added to your game, consider endorsing to help others find it too.

[b]Demo[/b]
[youtube]jCN6roH5mcQ[/youtube]
